theorems.name: Submission.cbr_vl_integrable_of_tsupport_subset
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ν K < ∞) → Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → tsupport f ⊆ U → Integrable f ν
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
